concentration_baseline.interpretation_guide: Use to compute Active Concentration Tilt: Active Tilt = User True Look-through Weight - S&P 500 Weight.

august_2024_tech_unwind.interpretation: Broad market benchmark fell -8.43%. A portfolio with heavy tech/semi overlap (e.g. QQQ + SMH) fell -18.2%, demonstrating beta > 2.0.

march_2023_svb_liquidity_shock.interpretation: Benchmark fell -3.44% during regional banking distress.

risk_metrics.interpretation: On a typical trading day, the S&P 500 has a 95% confidence 1-day downside bound of -1.42%. A user portfolio with 95% VaR of -3.9% is taking 2.75x market risk.
